concepts.name: Sinusoids & frequencies
concepts.summary: sin and cos at a ladder of frequencies freq_i=1/10000^(2i/d) — fast and slow hands that together pinpoint an index as a unique fingerprint. Pure trigonometry. (Upstairs: positional encoding and diffusion's timestep embedding.)

concepts.name: Rotation preserves length
concepts.summary: Rotating a vector changes its direction but not its length (sin^2+cos^2=1). The whole idea of RoPE: inject 'where' by rotating queries and keys without distorting 'what'.

concepts.name: The angle-addition identity
concepts.summary: cos(A)cos(B)+sin(A)sin(B)=cos(A-B): the dot product of two rotated vectors depends only on the difference of angles. This is why RoPE's rotations yield a RELATIVE sense of position.
